engine: crownd/finest's interior gallery — a FULL-BLEED carousel where each slide fills the whole viewport EDGE-TO-EDGE (no card chrome, no peek), swiping one full width at a time via round ‹ › arrows / drag / wheel / keyboard. Slides can be IMAGES or VIDEO; a video slide plays only while active AND on-screen (pauses otherwise). A '02 / 05' counter tracks position. Harvested from D_finest (F2: bedroom -> living -> bath -> pool, each filling the screen; some slides are video — 'several photos, swipe, one fills the screen, with video').

measured_teardown.move: the track translateX(-index * 100%); each .fmc-slide is flex 0 0 100% (exactly the viewport width — no peek). Arrows/drag/wheel/keys step by one. ease ~cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1). A video slide: muted+loop+playsinline, play() only when k===idx AND the stage is on-screen (IntersectionObserver), pause() otherwise. Drag follows the pointer (translateX calc(-idx*100% + dx px)); release past max(60px, 12% of width) steps, else snaps back; pointer move/up on WINDOW (F-08). Arrows disable at the ends (non-loop). Counter shows idx+1 / total.
measured_teardown.cited: finest interior gallery: full-bleed images that swipe horizontally with ‹ › arrows (bedroom -> living/dining -> bathroom -> pool); each slide fills the viewport edge-to-edge; some slides are video.

loop.what: wrap past the ends; when false the arrows disable at first/last.

drag.what: pointer drag / swipe (threshold max(60px, 12% of width); window-pointer F-08).

wheel.what: advance on horizontal wheel intent (off by default so vertical page scroll isn't hijacked).

entry: FullscreenMediaCarousel.create(target, opts) -> { go(i), next(), prev(), index(), count, destroy }. target = .fmc-stage > .fmc-track > .fmc-slide (each: img | video) x N + .fmc-prev/.fmc-next + optional .fmc-counter(.fmc-cur / .fmc-total). Videos auto-set muted+loop+playsinline. go(i) clamps (or wraps if loop).
law: transform: translateX (track) only; GPU; NO mix-blend over the media; NO WebGL; videos play only when active+on-screen (IntersectionObserver-gated), never touch video.currentTime (no scrub); reduced-motion -> instant index. owns_pin false, owns_scroll false (a triggered carousel). Drag move/up/cancel on WINDOW (F-08).
gate_mode: triggered (arrows / drag / wheel / keyboard), NOT scroll. Verify: each slide is FULL viewport width (slideW == stageW, no peek); step = translateX -100%; counter tracks idx; the video slide PLAYS when active and PAUSES when off; arrows disable at the ends. Distinct from horizontal-spec-carousel (framed card + peek + spec-row) and avatar-card-carousel (multi portrait cards + progress-line): this is ONE full-viewport media slide, no chrome. Smoothness via the TRIGGERED probe (stepping), not steady video.
proven: lab: 5 full-bleed slides on OUR QUADRO media (terrace render, clip-river-lite.webm VIDEO at idx1, day-front, macro-table, night). Measured live: slideW 1440 == stageW 1440 (edge-to-edge, no peek); step translateX 0 -> -100 -> -200 -> -400%; counter 01/05 -> 02/05 -> 03/05 -> 05/05; the video slide (idx1) playing=true when active, paused on a render slide; arrows disable at idx0 (prev) / idx4 (next). Screenshot (idx2 render): the QUADRO render filling the whole viewport + round ‹ › arrows + '03 / 05' counter (matches finest F2). Triggered probe (4x CPU throttle, next/prev cycles): 3/317 long frames (0.9%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors.
